text: welcome to week nine of the 2023
slingshot Racing League Apex Energy Cup
series season and this week we're at
Phoenix Raceway for 150 laps let's hop
straight into the qualifying
run as usual you want to spend your
first lap and a half building heat in
the tires and checking your line one
last time try to keep your left side
tires around the yellow line and let the
right side tires skate through the
corners as you get up to speed and run
through your first
lap as you approach your hot lap I would
recommend downshifting running up to the
outside wall in turn three and building
as much of a run as you can on your way
to the start Finish Line once you hit
the front straight away cut as much of
the dog leg as you can but make sure you
leave enough room to straighten the car
out leading into turn one dive into the
corner and try to keep the left side
tires below the first seam if you manage
your inputs well through the corner you
should be able to aim toward the yellow
line and get a good run out of turn
two once you reach turn three you'll
want to break around the second set of
cones in the catch fence and Pitch the
the car into the corner aim for the
yellow line and use your throttle to
guide the car through the corner if you
can get the nose rotated properly you
should be able to make use of the entire
width of the track on your way to the
finish

tires by running as close to the yill
line as possible on both ends of the

Dime in the corners but this track eats
through tires very quickly if you can
keep the right side tires on the car you
may be able to begin downshifting later

to experiment with the idea during
